activity.notes: Cardinal Richelieu became principal minister to Louis XIII in 1624 and remained the central royal minister until his death in 1642. ATLAS records formal service rather than sovereign rule.

sources.title: Richelieu, Armand Jean du Plessis duc de (1585-1642) — Bibliothèque nationale de France
sources.citation_text: The BnF authority record identifies Richelieu as principal minister of Louis XIII from 1624.
